cases.study_information: Predict total serum AUCinf (h·µg/mL) for ABS_201_300 after a single 300 mg/kg IV dose in cynomolgus monkeys. The matched 100 mg/kg cohort is visible. Target 300 mg/kg Cmax, clearance, half-life and all derived exposure parameters are withheld. Dose proportionality is a baseline assumption to test, not an observed answer. Each cohort contained two male and two female animals. Preserve the source label ABS-201 without assuming every AB001 alias identifies the same construct.

dependence_note: Shared experimental family; count in original-family sensitivity aggregation, not as independent biological replication.
title: Extrapolating high-dose primate exposure of an anti-PRLR antibody
